name: binanboot
description: Electron + React Binance futures quant trading console

scripts.pack: npm run typecheck && npm run build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: npm run typecheck && npm run build && electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: npm run typecheck && npm run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run typecheck && npm run build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:linux: npm run typecheck && npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage rpm --x64
scripts.publish:win: npm run typecheck && npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish always
scripts.publish:mac: npm run typecheck && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --publish always
scripts.publish:linux: npm run typecheck && npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage rpm --x64 --publish always
